abstract: Personal autonomy has been argued to be fundamental to well-being and is often discussed as an important driver of economic and political behavior. However, preferences for autonomy remain poorly understood. We propose a novel elicitation method for an individual’s intrinsic preference for choice autonomy that fully controls for instrumental value benefits of choice. We show that, while a majority of subjects in our experiment display a preference for choice autonomy, a significant minority is averse to their own choice.
abstract_zh: 个人自主性被认为是福祉的基础，并常被讨论为经济和政治行为的重要驱动力。然而，对自主性的偏好仍知之甚少。我们提出了一种新颖的诱导方法，用于评估个体对选择自主性的内在偏好，该方法完全控制了选择工具性价值的好处。我们表明，在我们的实验中，虽然大多数受试者表现出对选择自主性的偏好，但相当一部分少数群体却对自己的选择感到厌恶。
title: Choosing (not) to choose: Uncovering intrinsic preferences for choice autonomy
title_zh: 选择（不）选择：揭示对选择自主权的内在偏好

abstract: Options on agricultural futures contracts are often thinly traded, with a significant percentage of contracts having zero trading volume across various strikes and maturities. When trading volume is zero, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) manually determines options prices. This study evaluates the accuracy and adequacy of these artificial prices. The results indicate that when trades occur after one or more days of zero volume, prices move significantly, suggesting that options settled with zero volume may not effectively reflect market expectations regarding future prices. Moreover, higher implied volatilities are often observed for options far into or out of the money, particularly for options with zero trading volume. Our findings provide insights into the crop insurance program, where implied volatilities derived from options serve as a key parameter in determining premiums.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: The Informational Role of Trading Volume in Thinly Traded Options Markets

abstract: This study analyzes macro-economic aspects of industrial hemp in the U.S. economy with a focus on fiber products. Potential adoption of hemp is evaluated using a general equilibrium model. A policy such as a mandate could induce the use of hemp in production sectors involving fiber, paper, concrete, and building materials. This would cause a very slight decrease in overall societal welfare due to inefficiencies caused by allocations of resources away from market-based choices. However, the hemp-producing crops sector would expand by four percent and create 33,000 to 136,000 hemp-adjacent jobs depending on the policy scenario.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Macroeconomic Impacts of Industrial Hemp Expansion in the United States: A General Equilibrium Analysis

abstract: I estimate a hedonic model using the characteristics of over 24,000 dairy bulls sold between 2000 and 2009 to understand how selection indices that estimate the profitability of traits for producers compare to market valuations for those traits. I find that physical traits are valued much higher in the market: physical traits comprise 50% of an equivalent “hedonic index” versus 14% in the USDA’s index and 21% in an index produced by Holstein USA, a breed association. Changes in the USDA’s index are not completely reflected in bull prices, suggesting that changing these indices may have a limited impact on producer choices.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Market Valuations of Dairy Bull Characteristics and the Role of Selection Indices

abstract: Agricultural insurance serves as a crucial tool for risk management, helping to lessen the impact of natural disasters on farming and ensuring rural economic stability. This study analyzes survey data from the 2020-2021 China Land Economic Survey. We employ a Propensity Score Matching-Difference-in-Differences (PSM-DID) method to assess the effect of agricultural insurance on farmers’ fertilizer use. Results indicate that insured farmers tend to spend more on chemical fertilizers. These findings remain consistent across various models and outcome measures. Additional analysis suggests that this effect primarily arises from changes in crop selection and farmers’ risk tolerance. Policymakers could consider designing insurance policies that link fertilizer application levels to subsidies, expanding education and agricultural training, and encouraging practices such as crop rotation.
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Is Agricultural Insurance a Panacea for a Better Environment? Fertilizer Usage by Chinese Farmers

abstract: This study quantifies health damages from dairy CAFO air emissions in New Mexico using farm-level atmospheric dispersion modeling, epidemiological concentration-response functions, and economic valuation. We estimate 20.6 annual premature deaths and $217.66 million in health costs (90% CI: $146.8Ð$297.6 million), equivalent to 15% of state dairy revenues. Over 99% of damages arise from unregulated ammonia emissions forming secondary PM2.5. Per-cow damages range from $544 (rural) to $1,086 (metro), driven by receptor population density rather than farm size. Extrapolation to major dairy states suggests national damages of $10.1Ð$64.9 billion annually, with a preferred estimate of $33.4 billion.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Health Damages from Dairy Air Pollution: Evidence from New Mexico

abstract: We investigate the complementarity and adoption intensity of ecological agriculture practices (EAPs) among Midwestern farmers, with a focus on environmental stewardship and profit-maximization motives. Using survey-level data on farmer characteristics in the US Midwest, we employ multivariate probit (MVP) and Poisson regressions to assess these linkages. The MVP results indicate that the degree of complementarity between EAPs varies in magnitude, with the highest complementarity between diversified crop rotation and integrated crop-livestock systems (50%). Regarding the adoption intensity, we find that farmersÕ decisions are influenced by both ecological and economic interests, with environmental stewardship motive playing a greater role.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Adoption Dynamics of Ecological Agriculture Practices: Understanding the Complementarity and Intensity in the US Midwest

abstract: The U.S. dairy farm industry is subject to milk and feed price volatility. The Dairy Margin Coverage (DMC) program, and its predecessor, the Margin Protection Program for Dairy (MPP), are federal risk management programs for dairy producers that account for input (feed) and output (milk) prices. Under these programs, farmers receive payments based on the national margin between the U.S. All-Milk price and a national feed cost. We use a fractional logit regression to estimate factors associated with farm DMC/MPP participation. Results indicate that positive expected payouts led to higher participation while the presence of an Amish population decreased participation.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Profit Margin Protection Program Participation by US Dairy Farmers

abstract: The Dungeness crab fishery textemdash the most economically valuable on the U.S. West Coast textemdash has faced repeated, climate-driven disruptions over the past decade due to harmful algal blooms (HABs). These blooms, fueled by warming ocean temperatures, lead crabs to ingest toxin-producing algae, making them unsafe for human consumption. In response, fisheries managers have traditionally shut down the fishery, triggering substantial economic losses. To reduce these losses, some West Coast states have turned to evisceration orders, which allow crabs to be harvested during HABs if their toxin-containing intestines are removed before sale. However, the economic viability of this strategy depends on how it affects ex-vessel prices, i.e., the prices harvesters receive at the dock. This study quantifies the impact of evisceration orders on ex-vessel prices in Washington’s non-tribal fishery using quasi-experimental data from a 2021 HAB event. Employing both a difference-in-differences approach and structural demand estimation, we find that evisceration orders led to a decline in ex-vessel prices ranging between 26.5-33.5%. These results reveal a significant economic trade-off: while evisceration orders may preserve fishing opportunities during HABs, they also substantially erode market value. Our findings offer critical insights for designing adaptive fishery management strategies that protect public health while supporting industry resilience in an era of accelerating ocean change.
journal: Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Price Impacts of Evisceration Orders in the Dungeness Crab Fishery

abstract: We theoretically and empirically explore club-based promotions in hierarchical organizations. A game-theoretic model shows that strategic ambiguity in promotions—more specifically, an incentive scheme in which only top performers who pass a relative-performance threshold are eligible for promotions—may outperform single-prize tournaments in terms of both effort and leaders’ flexibility over personnel. Selection among threshold passers is independent of their performance and the discretionary choice of the leaders. Analysis of local officials’ career records in hierarchical governments in China over a 16-year period validates the existence of club-based patterns in governmental promotions. Thresholds are more lenient for higher-ranked positions and when relative performance is harder to measure.
abstract_zh: 我们从理论与实证两个维度探讨了层级组织中的俱乐部式晋升机制。一个博弈论模型表明，晋升中的策略性模糊——具体而言，即一种激励方案，其中只有超过相对绩效门槛的顶尖表现者才有资格获得晋升——在努力程度和领导者对人事安排的灵活性方面，可能优于单一奖项竞赛。门槛通过者的选拔与其表现无关，且不受领导者的自由裁量影响。对中国层级政府中地方官员16年职业生涯记录的分析，验证了政府晋升中俱乐部式模式的存在。门槛对于更高层级的职位以及相对绩效难以衡量时更为宽松。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The promotion club
title_zh: 推广俱乐部

abstract: We study how fluctuations in investor attention affect stock return synchronicity. For a sample of 734 stocks from 19 countries, we document that synchronicity increases when international soccer matches distract investors, suggesting that investors pay less attention to firm-specific news. Next, we show that synchronicity increases even more as matches become more important and when the national team is (closely) trailing rather than when it is leading during a match. These results are in line with Kahneman’s (1973) capacity model of attention, with loss aversion and with a role for suspense and underscore how fluctuations in investor attention affect price formation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了投资者注意力波动如何影响股票收益同步性。基于19个国家734只股票的样本，我们发现当国际足球比赛分散投资者注意力时，股票收益同步性会上升，这表明投资者对公司特定新闻的关注度降低。进一步研究表明，随着比赛重要性增加，以及当国家队在比赛中处于（微弱）落后而非领先状态时，同步性上升幅度更大。这些结果与卡尼曼（1973）的注意力容量模型、损失厌恶理论以及悬念的作用机制相吻合，并凸显了投资者注意力波动如何影响价格形成过程。
title: Distraction and Stock Return Synchronicity: Evidence from the Field
title_zh: 分心与股票回报同步性：来自实地证据

abstract: Professional service for digital technology like agricultural drones lowers transaction costs and scope thresholds for smallholders. Meanwhile, perceptual adoption barriers remain underexplored. We conduct a two‐stage choice experiment with a randomized video‐based information treatment among 384 Chinese crop farmers to measure its effect on farmers' willingness to pay (WTP) for agricultural drone services (ADS). While video‐based information significantly reduces farmers' WTP for contracts relative to oral agreements, it increases WTP for overall drone services among farmers who are younger, higher‐income, cultivate larger‐scale farms near tractor roads, have limited access to digital dissemination, and show lower risk preferences. By incorporating perceived uncertainty and risk management into the information‐adoption framework, we provide insights for policy support of digital agriculture service markets.
abstract_zh: 农业无人机等数字技术的专业服务降低了小农户的交易成本和规模门槛。然而，感知层面的采用障碍仍未得到充分研究。我们针对384名中国种植农户开展了一项两阶段选择实验，并采用随机视频信息干预措施，以衡量其对农户农业无人机服务支付意愿的影响。研究发现，与口头协议相比，视频信息显著降低了农户对合同的支付意愿，但提高了年轻、高收入、在机耕道附近经营较大规模农场、数字传播渠道有限且风险偏好较低的农户对整体无人机服务的支付意愿。通过将感知不确定性和风险管理纳入信息采纳分析框架，我们为数字农业服务市场的政策支持提供了启示。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: How Video‐Based Information Affects Farmers' Willingness to Pay for Drone Services
title_zh: 视频信息如何影响农民对无人机服务支付意愿

abstract: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), scheduled to become fully operational in 2026, is designed to complement the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) by replacing free emission allowances and preventing carbon leakage to non‐EU regions. CBAM initially covers energy‐intensive sectors, including mineral nitrogen (N) fertiliser production. Although mineral N fertiliser production is already included in the EU ETS, it is currently exempt from carbon charges owing to full compensation through free allowances. The phase‐out of these allowances and the introduction of CBAM are expected to increase the prices of both imported and domestically produced fertilisers, indirectly affecting the EU agricultural sector. This study quantitatively assesses the impacts of the expected fertiliser price changes on the EU agricultural sector and related environmental outcomes using the Modular Applied GeNeral Equilibrium Tool (MAGNET) and the Common Agricultural Policy Regionalised Impact (CAPRI) model. The results indicate that the combined effect of phasing out free allowances and implementing CBAM will double mineral N fertiliser prices. Higher prices are projected to reduce demand, leading to a 21.4% decline in domestic production and a 37% reduction in imports. Overall mineral N fertiliser use in the EU is expected to decrease by 22%, partially replaced by manure. Consequently, EU agricultural factor income is projected to fall by 7.7%, primarily affecting high‐input regions. Meanwhile, non‐EU agricultural income is projected to rise slightly by 0.05%, driven by higher exports. EU agricultural greenhouse gas emissions are expected to decrease by 22 megatons of CO 2 ‐equivalent, with no significant increase globally.
abstract_zh: 碳边境调节机制（CBAM）计划于2026年全面实施，旨在通过取代免费排放配额并防止碳泄漏至非欧盟地区，对欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）形成补充。CBAM最初覆盖能源密集型行业，包括矿物氮肥生产。尽管矿物氮肥生产已被纳入欧盟ETS，但目前因通过免费配额获得全额补偿而免于碳成本。这些配额的逐步取消及CBAM的引入预计将推高进口和本土化肥价格，间接影响欧盟农业部门。本研究采用模块化应用一般均衡工具（MAGNET）与共同农业政策区域化影响模型（CAPRI），定量评估预期化肥价格变化对欧盟农业部门及相关环境结果的影响。结果表明，取消免费配额与实施CBAM的叠加效应将使矿物氮肥价格翻倍。价格上涨预计将抑制需求，导致本土产量下降21.4%，进口量减少37%。欧盟矿物氮肥总使用量预计下降22%，部分被粪肥替代。受此影响，欧盟农业要素收入预计下降7.7%，高投入地区受冲击最为显著。与此同时，非欧盟地区农业收入因出口增长预计小幅上升0.05%。欧盟农业温室气体排放预计减少2200万吨二氧化碳当量，且全球范围内未出现显著增长。
title: Fertilising Climate Policy: The Dual Impact of CBAM on EU Agricultural Emissions and Regional Disparities
title_zh: 施肥气候政策：CBAM对欧盟农业排放与区域差异的双重影响

abstract: We consider a payment arrangement in which transfers and holdings of currency, but not of real resources, can be recorded and traced by monitoring technology. We show that this payment arrangement improves upon traditional cash payments, allowing transfers of currency among strangers, which can be interpreted as monetary loans.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一种支付安排，其中货币的转移和持有（而非实际资源）可通过监控技术进行记录和追踪。研究表明，这种支付安排优于传统的现金支付，允许陌生人之间进行货币转移，这可以理解为货币贷款。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Optimal Payment Arrangement in a Cash‐Less Monetary Economy
title_zh: 无现金货币经济中的最优支付安排

abstract: The European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) experienced sharp allowance price increases from 2018 onward, prompting claims that rational bubbles were driving the surge. We reassess this hypothesis using expectations based on futures prices. We modify an existing testing approach under risk‐neutrality and show that this version of the test is valid in the presence of a dynamic risk premium and robust when the underlying fundamental exhibits a unit root or mildly explosive behavior. Using weekly spot and futures data from 2013 to 2023, we find no evidence of rational bubbles. The evidence is consistent with shifting allowance‐scarcity expectations.
abstract_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）自2018年起经历了配额价格大幅上涨，引发关于理性泡沫推动价格飙升的论断。我们基于期货价格所反映的预期重新评估了这一假说。通过修正风险中性条件下的现有检验方法，我们证明该检验版本在存在动态风险溢价时依然有效，且当基础基本面呈现单位根或轻度爆炸性行为时具有稳健性。基于2013年至2023年的周度现货与期货数据，我们未发现理性泡沫的证据。研究结果与配额稀缺性预期变化这一解释相一致。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: EU ETS Market Expectations and Rational Bubbles
title_zh: 欧盟排放交易体系市场预期与理性泡沫

abstract: Platform interoperability is considered a powerful tool to promote competition in digital markets when network effects are at play. We study the incentives of two competing ad-funded platforms to provide interoperability in a setting where consumers can single-home or multi-home and decide how much time to spend online. When the platforms are symmetric, perfect interoperability emerges in equilibrium and is socially efficient. When a larger platform has an installed base of customers, its incentive to make its services interoperable is lower than for the smaller platform. Interoperability does not emerge in equilibrium if the installed base is sufficiently large. However, mandating interoperability between the asymmetric platforms is not always socially optimal.
abstract_zh: 平台互操作性被视为在网络效应发挥作用时促进数字市场竞争的有力工具。我们研究了在消费者可以选择单归属或多归属并决定在线时间投入的背景下，两家竞争性广告支持型平台提供互操作性的激励。当平台对称时，完全互操作性在均衡中出现且具有社会效率。当较大平台拥有既定的客户基础时，其提供互操作服务的激励低于较小平台。若既定基础足够大，互操作性不会在均衡中出现。然而，强制不对称平台之间的互操作性并非总是社会最优的。
title: Interoperability Between Ad‐Financed Platforms With Endogenous Multi‐Homing
title_zh: 内生多归属下广告融资平台的互操作性

abstract: We study an agency model with two sequential tasks, an initial task (e.g., development), which requires unverifiable effort, and a final task (e.g., production), whose environment is privately known only to the agent. The principal can either perform the initial task herself (hands-on management) or delegate it to the agent (hands-off management). We show that when the cost of effort for the initial task is low, hands-on management is optimal, as it mitigates the distortion caused by agent shirking. However, as the cost of effort increases, hands-off management becomes preferable. Under hands-on management, the principal's inability to commit leads her to overinvest in the initial task, which in turn exacerbates inefficiencies in the final task due to the agent's information rent. In contrast, hands-off management, despite the agent's shirking incentive, helps better target effort toward favorable project environments. Our analysis also reveals how effort costs can create systematic biases toward one management style over the other.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个连续任务的代理模型：初始任务（如开发），需要不可验证的努力；以及最终任务（如生产），其环境仅由代理私下知晓。委托人可以选择亲自执行初始任务（亲力亲为式管理），或将其委托给代理（放手式管理）。我们表明，当初始任务的努力成本较低时，亲力亲为式管理为最优，因为它能缓解代理偷懒所导致的扭曲。然而，随着努力成本的增加，放手式管理变得更为可取。在亲力亲为式管理下，委托人无法承诺会导致其对初始任务过度投资，进而因代理的信息租金而加剧最终任务中的效率低下。相比之下，放手式管理尽管存在代理的偷懒激励，却有助于将努力更精准地投向有利的项目环境。我们的分析还揭示了努力成本如何系统性地偏向于某一种管理风格。
title: Gaining Control by Losing Control
title_zh: 通过失去控制来获得控制

abstract: We focus on the determinants of pharmaceutical drug prices. Using data from the Brazilian pharmaceutical market, we find large variations in drug prices across buyers, drug classes, and time periods. Our estimation results provide evidence that transaction-specific determinants between buyers and sellers (e.g., transaction volume, buyer's loyalty, multiple drug purchases from the same seller) exert strong effects on drug prices. Our counterfactuals show that group purchasing organizations achieve price reductions that vary across drug classes and that these price reductions primarily depend on buyer price sensitivity.
abstract_zh: 我们聚焦于药品价格的决定因素。利用巴西药品市场的数据，我们发现药品价格在购买者、药品类别及时间段之间存在显著差异。估计结果表明，买卖双方之间的交易特定因素（如交易量、购买者忠诚度、从同一卖方购买多种药品）对药品价格产生强烈影响。反事实分析显示，团体采购组织实现的降价幅度因药品类别而异，且这些降价主要取决于购买者的价格敏感度。
title: The Determinants of Negotiated Pharmaceutical Prices
title_zh: 谈判药品价格的决定因素

abstract: Consider suppliers whose comparative advantages, which are unknown to a buyer, depend on the quantity procured. The distortions of the buyer purchase policy differs depending on the market characteristics. In a large market, either it overbuys to suppliers with steep marginal costs, who are better at producing a small volume; or it withholds the demand it addresses to suppliers with flatter marginal costs, who are better at producing a large volume. The latter policy is implemented through a concave tariff offered to the less capacity constrained suppliers. In a small market, demand withholding prevails and some suppliers can be excluded.
abstract_zh: 考虑那些比较优势不为买方所知、且取决于采购数量的供应商。买方采购政策的扭曲程度因市场特征而异。在大市场中，要么对边际成本陡峭、擅长小批量生产的供应商过度采购；要么对边际成本平缓、擅长大批量生产的供应商缩减需求。后一种政策通过向产能约束较小的供应商提供凹形关税来实现。在小市场中，需求缩减占主导地位，部分供应商可能被排除在外。
title: Overbuying, Demand Withholding, and Single Sourcing Under Decreasing Returns
title_zh: 递减收益下的过度购买、需求抑制与单一采购

abstract: We provide a novel empirical analysis of the role of technology licensing, between competitors, for genetically engineered (GE) traits in the US seed industry. We extend the standard differentiated-product Bertrand pricing model to include trait licensing, which permits us to recover marginal costs and (otherwise unobserved) royalty rates. Estimation relies on a large dataset of farm-level seed purchases. We find that markups over marginal cost are sizeable, and royalties for GE traits contribute a non-trivial amount to these markups. Licensing GE traits to competitors benefits all seed sellers and, notwithstanding its strategic effect on pricing, also increases total market surplus.
abstract_zh: 我们针对美国种子行业中，竞争对手之间基因工程（GE）性状技术许可的作用，提供了一项新颖的实证分析。我们将标准差异化产品伯特兰定价模型扩展至包含性状许可，从而能够恢复边际成本和（原本不可观测的）特许权使用费率。估计依赖于农场层面种子购买的大型数据集。我们发现，边际成本之上的加成幅度显著，且GE性状的特许权使用费对这些加成贡献了不可忽视的部分。将GE性状许可给竞争对手有利于所有种子销售商，并且，尽管其对定价具有战略影响，也增加了总市场剩余。
title: Innovation, Licensing, and Competition: Evidence From Genetically Engineered Crops
title_zh: 创新、许可与竞争：来自转基因作物的证据

abstract: How does antitrust enforcement affect innovation when patents are the main barrier to entry? I address this question by empirically studying the US antitrust case against Xerox, the former monopolist in the market for plain-paper copiers. In 1975, Xerox accepted a consent decree whose primary remedy was compulsory licensing of all its copier-technology patents in the US and abroad. I show that this antitrust intervention promoted innovation by other firms in the copier industry, measured by a disproportionate increase in patenting in technology classes with a higher propensity for containing copier-related inventions. This effect is driven by Japanese competitors, whose patenting became more novel and diverse as they started developing smaller desktop copiers.
abstract_zh: 当专利构成主要进入壁垒时，反垄断执法如何影响创新？我通过实证研究美国针对施乐公司（前普通纸复印机市场垄断者）的反垄断案件来回答这一问题。1975年，施乐接受了同意令，其主要救济措施是强制许可其在美国及国外的所有复印机技术专利。我证明，这一反垄断干预促进了其他企业在复印机行业的创新，表现为在更可能包含复印机相关发明的技术类别中，专利数量不成比例地增加。这一效应由日本竞争者驱动，随着他们开始开发更小的台式复印机，其专利变得更加新颖和多样化。
title: Patents, Antitrust, and Innovation: Evidence From the Xerox Case
title_zh: 专利、反垄断与创新：来自施乐案的证据

abstract: A data analytics company delivers an efficiency by supplying a pricing algorithm that allows prices to more effectively respond to demand variation. In this setting, I consider a new form of hub-and-spoke collusion: A data analytics company (hub) coordinates the prices of competitors (spokes) through its pricing algorithm. A novel finding is that the data analytics company's efficiency is a facilitating factor for collusion; a rise in this efficiency increases the supracompetitive markup and the incremental profit from collusion. Thus, markets in which a third party's services are solidly grounded in efficiency still warrant scrutiny by competition authorities because they are more prone to the emergence of collusion and anticompetitive harm.
abstract_zh: 一家数据分析公司通过提供定价算法来提升效率，使价格能更有效地响应需求变化。在此背景下，我探讨了一种新型的轴辐式合谋形式：数据分析公司（轴心）通过其定价算法协调竞争对手（辐条）的价格。一个新颖的发现是，数据分析公司的效率是促进合谋的因素；这种效率的提升会增加超竞争加成和合谋带来的增量利润。因此，即使第三方服务基于坚实的效率基础，市场仍应受到竞争当局的审查，因为这些市场更易出现合谋和反竞争损害。
title: Hub‐and‐Spoke Collusion With a Third‐Party Pricing Algorithm
title_zh: 轴辐式合谋与第三方定价算法

abstract: We introduce consumer choice into a search-theoretic model of monetary exchange. In contrast to standard search models featuring bilateral meetings, consumers can meet multiple sellers and choose a seller with whom to trade. Market power is endogenized through competitive search and it is influenced by the degree of consumer choice. We consider the effects of greater consumer choice on both market power and the welfare cost of inflation. Surprisingly, we find that greater consumer choice can have a non-monotonic effect on market power. At lower levels of consumer choice, an increase in the degree of consumer choice tends to increase firms’ market power, while the opposite is true at higher levels. When we calibrate the model to U.S. data, we find that despite greater consumer choice having a positive effect on welfare overall, it can also amplify the negative welfare effects of inflation, making it significantly more costly.
abstract_zh: 我们将消费者选择引入货币交换的搜寻理论模型中。与标准搜寻模型中双边会面的设定不同，消费者能够接触多个卖家并选择交易对象。市场势力通过竞争性搜寻内生决定，并受消费者选择程度的影响。我们考察了更大程度的消费者选择对市场势力及通货膨胀福利成本的影响。令人意外的是，我们发现更大程度的消费者选择对市场势力的影响可能呈现非单调性。在消费者选择程度较低时，增加消费者选择程度往往提升企业的市场势力，而在较高水平时则相反。当我们将模型校准至美国数据时，发现尽管更大程度的消费者选择总体上对福利有正面影响，但它也可能放大通货膨胀的负面福利效应，使其代价显著增加。
title: Consumer choice, market power, and inflation
title_zh: 消费者选择、市场势力与通货膨胀

abstract: Urban green infrastructure is a nature-based remedy for urban environmental, social and economic problems. This study mapped and quantified urban green infrastructure (UGI) dynamics in Dire Dawa city and projected future changes for 2055. Landsat and Sentinel-2 data, obtained from the USGS and ESA, respectively, were accessed via the Google Earth Engine platform. A random forest model was employed to classify the images, achieving kappa coefficients of 97%, 88%, 89%, and 90% for the years 1995, 2005, 2016, and 2025, respectively. To quantify and predict UGI dynamics, this study utilized the CA-Markov model and the multi-layer perceptron-artificial neural network (MLP-ANN) method. The results revealed a significant decline in UGI area: reductions of 454.96 ha (1995–2005), 884.22 ha (2005–2016), 269.40 ha (2016–2025), and a total loss of 1608.58 ha (1995–2025). Over the 30-year period (1995–2025), Dire Dawa’s UGI decreased by 23%, while built-up areas increased by 31.9%, and bare land decreased by 8.4%. Spatially, UGI fragmentation was most pronounced in the northern, southern, and central parts of the city. The findings suggest that existing urban planning, management, and land-use policies in Dire Dawa have failed to mitigate UGI loss. Therefore, analyzing UGI dynamics is crucial for informing future urban planning, management strategies, and policymaking to address fragmentation and promote sustainable urban development.
abstract_zh: 城市绿色基础设施是应对城市环境、社会和经济问题的基于自然的解决方案。本研究对德雷达瓦市城市绿色基础设施（UGI）动态进行了制图与量化，并预测了2055年的未来变化。研究使用了分别从美国地质调查局（USGS）和欧洲空间局（ESA）获取的Landsat和Sentinel-2数据，并通过谷歌地球引擎平台进行访问。采用随机森林模型对影像进行分类，1995年、2005年、2016年和2025年的Kappa系数分别达到97%、88%、89%和90%。为量化和预测UGI动态，本研究采用了CA-Markov模型和多层感知器-人工神经网络（MLP-ANN）方法。结果表明，UGI面积显著下降：1995–2005年减少454.96公顷，2005–2016年减少884.22公顷，2016–2025年减少269.40公顷，1995–2025年总损失达1608.58公顷。在30年期间（1995–2025年），德雷达瓦的UGI减少了23%，而建成区面积增加了31.9%，裸地减少了8.4%。在空间上，UGI破碎化在城市北部、南部和中部最为显著。研究结果表明，德雷达瓦现有的城市规划、管理和土地利用政策未能有效遏制UGI的流失。因此，分析UGI动态对于指导未来城市规划、管理策略和政策制定，以应对破碎化问题并促进可持续城市发展至关重要。
title: Mapping, quantifying and predicting future urban green infrastructure dynamics: The case study of Dire Dawa, Ethiopia
title_zh: 绘制、量化与预测未来城市绿色基础设施动态：以埃塞俄比亚德雷达瓦为例

abstract: This paper studies the estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models where the factor loadings are unknown functions of observed individual characteristics, and the idiosyncratic error terms are subject to conditional quantile restrictions. We propose a three-stage estimation procedure that is easy to implement and has nice properties. The convergence rates, the limiting distributions of the estimated factors and loading functions, plus a consistent selection criterion for the number of factors at each quantile are derived under general conditions. Our proposed estimators are shown to work satisfactorily when: (i) the idiosyncratic errors have heavy tails, (ii) the time dimension of the panel dataset is not large, and (iii) the number of factors differs from the number of characteristics. Further, a consistent estimation method based on quantile factor analysis and sieve regression is proposed when the factor loadings depend on additional unobserved characteristics. Monte Carlo simulations and an empirical application aimed at estimating the loading functions of the daily returns of a large panel of S&P 500 index securities help illustrate these properties.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了基于特征的分位数因子模型的估计问题，其中因子载荷是观测个体特征的未知函数，且 idiosyncratic 误差项受条件分位数约束。我们提出了一种易于实现且具有良好性质的三阶段估计程序。在一般条件下，我们推导了估计因子和载荷函数的收敛速率、极限分布，以及各分位数下因子数量的一致选择准则。我们提出的估计器在以下情况下表现良好：（i）idiosyncratic 误差具有重尾分布，（ii）面板数据集的时间维度不大，（iii）因子数量与特征数量不同。此外，当因子载荷依赖于额外的未观测特征时，我们提出了一种基于分位数因子分析和筛回归的一致估计方法。蒙特卡洛模拟以及旨在估计标普500指数证券大面板日收益载荷函数的实证应用，有助于说明这些性质。
source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: Estimation of characteristics-based quantile factor models
title_zh: 基于特征的分位数因子模型的估计

abstract: How do changing shopping habits shape cities? We investigate this question in the context of major shop closures. Leveraging geocoded crime and economic data at the level of small areas covering England and Wales, we examine the effects of these closures on criminal activity and urban dynamics. Our findings reveal that closures lead to significant increases in crime. These effects survive a battery of robustness checks and are highly localised. We also find evidence for wider changes to urban areas triggered by the closures. Our results highlight broader implications for declining inner-city areas and the “death of the high street”.
abstract_zh: 不断变化的购物习惯如何塑造城市？我们以大型商店关闭为背景探讨这一问题。利用覆盖英格兰和威尔士的小区域地理编码犯罪与经济数据，我们考察了这些关闭对犯罪活动和城市动态的影响。研究发现，商店关闭导致犯罪显著增加。这些效应在多项稳健性检验中依然存在，且具有高度局部性。我们还发现了关闭引发城市区域更广泛变化的证据。我们的结果凸显了内城区衰退及“高街之死”的更广泛影响。
title: The death of the “High Street”? Main street closures, social disorder and urban change
title_zh: 高街”之死？主街关闭、社会失序与城市变迁

abstract: We study the uneven effects of a commodity cycle, documenting its impact across workers based on their skill level and the region where they live. To this end, we develop a dynamic quantitative model of a multi-region economy featuring spatial linkages (interregional trade and migration) and downward wage rigidity. Empirically, we focus on Brazil’s experience during the commodity boom of the 2000s and subsequent bust of the 2010s. The skill premium falls during the boom, while the extent of downward wage rigidity determines whether it reverts or maintains its decline during the bust. In addition, there is substantial heterogeneity across Brazilian states in the gains from the commodity cycle. Finally, we build counterfactuals to show that both spatial linkages (interregional migration and interregional trade) and downward wage rigidity jointly shape the impact of the commodity cycle on the skill premium, real wages, unemployment, and spatial disparities.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大宗商品周期的不均衡影响，记录了其对不同技能水平和居住地区工人的作用。为此，我们构建了一个包含空间联系（区域间贸易与迁移）和工资下行刚性的多区域经济动态量化模型。实证上，我们聚焦于巴西在2000年代大宗商品繁荣及2010年代随之而来的衰退期间的经历。技能溢价在繁荣期下降，而工资下行刚性的程度决定了其在衰退期是回升还是维持下降。此外，巴西各州在大宗商品周期中的收益存在显著异质性。最后，我们通过反事实分析表明，空间联系（区域间迁移与区域间贸易）和工资下行刚性共同塑造了大宗商品周期对技能溢价、实际工资、失业率及空间差异的影响。
title: Spatial linkages and the uneven effects of a commodity boom
title_zh: 空间关联与大宗商品繁荣的非均衡效应

abstract: We study how relationship-specific learning affects the joint dynamics of exports and trade finance. Using micro-level Chilean data, we document that new exporters initially rely on cash-in-advance payments and gradually transition to providing trade credit as relationships mature, with faster transitions in riskier destinations and for less experienced firms. Motivated by this, we develop a general equilibrium trade model that integrates learning about foreign demand and counterparty risk together with firms’ endogenous export and trade finance choices. We use the model to investigate the role of learning and risks in shaping export adjustments and quantify the impact of shocks to the cost of trade finance on aggregate exports. We find that the response to these shocks depends on the riskiness of the destination and is amplified by the disruption of long-term trading relationships.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了关系特定性学习如何影响出口与贸易融资的联合动态。利用智利微观层面数据，我们记录了新出口商最初依赖预付现金支付，并随着关系成熟逐步转向提供贸易信贷，且在风险更高的目的地和缺乏经验的企业中，这一转变速度更快。受此启发，我们构建了一个一般均衡贸易模型，该模型整合了对外国需求和交易对手风险的学习，以及企业内生性的出口和贸易融资选择。我们利用该模型探讨学习与风险在塑造出口调整中的作用，并量化贸易融资成本冲击对总体出口的影响。我们发现，对这些冲击的响应取决于目的地的风险程度，并因长期贸易关系的破裂而被放大。
title: International trade finance and learning dynamics
title_zh: 国际贸易融资与学习动态

abstract: This paper examines the impact of political connections on firms’ make-or-buy decisions, focusing on outsourcing intensity. We develop a stylized model to illustrate two mechanisms. For small buyers, political connections mitigate bargaining disadvantages and increase the buyer’s share of revenue, which strengthens incentives to undertake headquarters investment and thus raises the attractiveness of outsourcing (a bargaining-power channel). For large buyers, political connections may increase the reputational costs of opportunistic behavior, thereby reducing hold-up risk, encouraging supplier investment, and increasing outsourcing (a reputational-discipline channel). For buyers of intermediate size, political connections have little effect, as such firms neither face severe bargaining disadvantages nor strong reputational constraints. Using data on Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2020, we find evidence consistent with these mechanisms: political connections are associated with higher outsourcing intensity for small and large firms, while the relationship is weak for medium-sized firms.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了政治关联对企业自制或外购决策的影响，重点关注外包强度。我们构建了一个简化模型以阐述两种机制。对于小型买方，政治关联缓解了议价劣势，增加了买方在收入中的份额，从而强化了进行总部投资的激励，进而提升了外包的吸引力（议价能力渠道）。对于大型买方，政治关联可能增加机会主义行为的声誉成本，从而降低套牢风险，鼓励供应商投资，并促进外包（声誉约束渠道）。对于规模居中的买方，政治关联影响甚微，因为此类企业既未面临严重的议价劣势，也未受到强烈的声誉约束。利用2010年至2020年中国上市公司数据，我们发现了与这些机制相一致的证据：政治关联与小型和大型企业的外包强度呈正相关，而对中型企业而言，这一关系较弱。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Political connections, contract imperfections, and firm outsourcing
title_zh: 政治关联、合同不完全性与企业外包

abstract: We study the effects of reducing formalization costs by exploiting the introduction of a simplified tax regime for microentrepreneurs in Brazil. Using novel administrative data and industry-level eligibility criteria, we show that a large reduction in entry and compliance costs significantly increased formal firm creation. Despite the increase in formalization, newly formal firms exhibit no growth or earnings gains. We then evaluate the new tax system’s fiscal consequences, showing that the expansion in social security coverage generated costs that exceed the additional tax revenue collected by 2.56 times. These costs arise as microentrepreneurs gain access to subsidized contributory benefits after registering through the system, highlighting the broader social value of bringing microentrepreneurs into the formal sector even in the absence of positive government net revenue or improvements in firm performance.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用巴西为微型企业家引入简化税收制度的机会，研究了降低正规化成本的影响。借助新颖的行政数据和行业层面的资格标准，我们表明，大幅降低进入和合规成本显著增加了正规企业的创立。尽管正规化有所增加，新正规化的企业在增长或收益方面并未展现出改善。随后，我们评估了新税收制度的财政后果，显示社会保障覆盖范围的扩大所产生的成本，是额外征收税收收入的2.56倍。这些成本源于微型企业家在通过该系统注册后获得补贴性缴费福利，这凸显了即使在没有政府净收入为正或企业绩效改善的情况下，将微型企业家纳入正规部门也具有更广泛的社会价值。
title: Formalizing microentrepreneurs through targeted tax systems: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 通过目标税制规范微型企业家：来自巴西的证据

abstract: We implement Pigovian transport pricing in a field experiment in urban agglomerations of Switzerland over the course of 8 weeks. Our pricing considers the external costs from climate damages, health outcomes from pollution, accidents and physical activity, and congestion. It varies across time, space and mode of transport and is deducted from a budget provided to GPS-tracked participants. The treatment significantly reduces the external costs of transport during the course of the experiment. The main underlying mechanism is a shift away from driving towards other modes, such as public transport, walking and cycling. Providing information about the external costs of transport alone is insufficient to change the transport behavior for the sample majority. A time-invariant tax on CO2 and health-related externalities would capture most of the welfare gains associated with the first-best policy.
abstract_zh: 我们在瑞士城市群开展了一项为期8周的实地实验，实施了庇古式交通定价方案。该定价体系综合考虑了气候变化损害、污染导致的健康影响、交通事故、体力活动以及交通拥堵等外部成本，并根据时间、空间和交通方式动态调整。定价金额从提供给GPS追踪参与者的预算中扣除。实验期间，该干预措施显著降低了交通的外部成本。其主要作用机制是促使参与者从驾车出行转向公共交通、步行和骑行等其他交通方式。仅提供交通外部成本信息不足以改变样本中多数人的出行行为。对二氧化碳和健康相关外部性征收时间不变的税收，将能获取与最优政策相关的大部分福利收益。
title: Pigovian Transport Pricing in Practice
title_zh: 庇古运输定价的实践

abstract: We propose a novel channel through which rising income inequality affects job creation and macroeconomic outcomes. High-income households save relatively more in stocks and bonds but less in bank deposits. A rising top income share thereby increases the relative financing cost for bank-dependent firms, which in turn create fewer jobs compared to other firms. Exploiting variation in top income shares across US states and an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence for this channel. We then build a general equilibrium macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households and heterogeneous firms and calibrate it to our empirical estimates. The model shows that the secular rise in top incomes accounts for 13% of the decline in the employment share of small firms since 1980. Through the new channel, rising inequality also reduces the labor share and aggregate output. Model experiments show that ignoring the link between inequality and job creation understates welfare effects of income redistribution.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的传导渠道，通过该渠道，收入不平等加剧会影响就业创造和宏观经济结果。高收入家庭将更多储蓄配置于股票和债券，而较少存入银行存款。因此，顶层收入份额的上升提高了依赖银行融资的企业的相对融资成本，导致这些企业创造的就业岗位少于其他企业。利用美国各州顶层收入份额的差异以及工具变量策略，我们为这一传导渠道提供了证据。随后，我们构建了一个包含异质性家庭和异质性企业的一般均衡宏观经济模型，并根据实证估计结果对其进行校准。模型显示，自1980年以来，顶层收入份额的长期上升解释了小企业就业份额下降的13%。通过这一新渠道，收入不平等加剧还降低了劳动收入份额和总产出。模型实验表明，忽视不平等与就业创造之间的关联会低估收入再分配的福利效应。
title: Income Inequality and Job Creation
title_zh: 收入不平等与就业创造

abstract: We empirically examined the impact of gender equality on forest protection using data for 151 countries from 2000 to 2023 via panel estimation. The results supported that gender equality usually associates with more forest protection, which is reliable while we conducted regression by changing estimations, employing measurements of forest protection and gender equality. In addition, this positive impact is weakened by industrial structure, income inequality, governmental spending, while it is stronger among OECD countries. Moreover, the positive impact of gender equality on forest protection is weaker among right-wing governments and countries with political corruption, while it is strengthened by governmental effectiveness, political stability and regulatory quality. Finally, growing disasters such as epidemics and wet mass movement would reduce gender equality’s positive impact on forest protection, while renewable energy consumption would benefit for it. Our conclusions offered several policy implications for governments to promote forest protection.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2000年至2023年间151个国家的面板数据，实证考察了性别平等对森林保护的影响。研究结果支持性别平等通常与更有效的森林保护相关联，这一结论在通过变换估计方法、采用不同的森林保护与性别平等衡量指标进行回归后依然稳健。此外，这种积极影响会受到产业结构、收入不平等及政府支出的削弱，而在OECD国家中则更为显著。进一步地，性别平等对森林保护的正面作用在右翼政府及政治腐败严重的国家中较弱，而政府效能、政治稳定性及监管质量的提升则会强化这一效应。最后，诸如流行病和湿物质运动等日益增多的灾害会减弱性别平等对森林保护的积极影响，而可再生能源消费则对此有所助益。我们的研究结论为政府促进森林保护提供了多项政策启示。
china_relevance_reason: 2 位疑似中文姓名作者，且摘要/题名包含中国研究常见主题词，需要 AI 确认
title: Impact of gender equality on forest protection: Role of economic, social, political and energy factors
title_zh: 性别平等对森林保护的影响：经济、社会、政治与能源因素的作用

abstract: We develop a framework for decision-making under model uncertainty, grounded in Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization. In contrast to standard Kullback–Leibler approaches constrained by absolute continuity, Wasserstein ambiguity sets constructed via optimal transport permit the adversary to physically relocate probability mass to new states, capturing economically relevant support-shifting distortions—structural breaks, regime shifts, and catastrophic tail events—that the reference model excludes entirely. We integrate these state-shift distortions into both static and recursive dynamic decision problems, where agents optimize against the worst-case distribution within a transport budget. A data-driven bootstrap calibration procedure disciplines the degree of robustness by linking the ambiguity radius to statistical confidence sets. Applying the framework to asset pricing, we show that endogenous belief distortions amplify perceived variance, inducing precautionary savings that lower the risk-free rate and widen the equity premium. The geometric uncertainty propagates through persistent state dynamics, generating endogenous stochastic volatility akin to long-run risk. The resulting pricing kernel aligns with empirical Hansen–Jagannathan bounds without requiring implausibly high risk aversion or non-standard preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在模型不确定性下进行决策的框架，其基础是Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化。与受绝对连续性约束的标准Kullback–Leibler方法不同，通过最优传输构建的Wasserstein模糊集允许对抗者将概率质量物理性地移动到新状态，从而捕捉参考模型完全排除的、具有经济相关性的支持转移扭曲——结构性断裂、制度变迁和灾难性尾部事件。我们将这些状态转移扭曲整合到静态和递归动态决策问题中，其中代理在传输预算内针对最坏情况分布进行优化。一种数据驱动的自助法校准程序通过将模糊半径与统计置信集联系起来，对鲁棒性程度加以约束。将该框架应用于资产定价，我们表明内生信念扭曲会放大感知方差，引发预防性储蓄，从而降低无风险利率并扩大股权溢价。几何不确定性通过持久的状态动态传播，产生类似于长期风险的内生随机波动性。由此产生的定价核与经验上的Hansen–Jagannathan边界一致，而无需假设过高的风险厌恶或非标准偏好。
title: Wasserstein worst-case scenarios and asset pricing
title_zh: Wasserstein最坏情形与资产定价

abstract: This study examines whether mutual fund managers generate alpha through thematic investment strategies that select stocks poised to benefit from specific themes. Using textual analysis of 10-K filings, we identify stocks’ thematic exposures and construct each fund’s thematic concentration index (TCI) from its holdings. High-TCI funds significantly outperform, with a top-minus-bottom decile spread of 4.26% in annualized four-factor alpha. Managers’ thematic expertise is related to their undergraduate field of study. Outperformance arises from superior stock selection rather than theme-related timing, with an informational advantage on firm earnings, particularly in stocks exposed to themes related to managers’ undergraduate training.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共同基金经理是否通过主题投资策略（即选择有望从特定主题中受益的股票）创造超额收益。通过对10-K文件进行文本分析，我们识别出股票的主题暴露程度，并根据基金持仓构建了各基金的主题集中指数（TCI）。高TCI基金的表现显著优于其他基金，其最高与最低十分位组合的年化四因子阿尔法差值为4.26%。基金经理的主题专长与其本科专业领域相关。超额收益源于卓越的选股能力而非主题相关时机选择，且这种优势体现在对公司盈利的信息优势上，尤其当股票暴露的主题与基金经理本科专业背景相关时更为显著。
title: Thematic Concentration and Mutual Fund Performance
title_zh: 主题集中度与共同基金业绩

abstract: We develop a dynamic theory of “Partial Equilibrium Thinking” (PET), which micro-founds time-varying return extrapolation: extrapolative beliefs are present at all times, but only sometimes manifest themselves in explosive ways. We formalize the distinction between normal times shocks and “displacement shocks,” and study their interaction with extrapolative beliefs. In normal times, PET generates constant extrapolation and momentum. After a displacement shock that increases uncertainty, PET leads to stronger and time-varying extrapolation, triggering bubbles and endogenous crashes. Our theory sheds light on both market dynamics in normal times and Kindleberger’s narrative of bubbles within a unified framework. (JEL D84, G12, G41)
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个“局部均衡思维”（PET）的动态理论，该理论为时变回报外推提供了微观基础：外推信念始终存在，但仅在特定时期以爆发性方式显现。我们形式化了正常时期冲击与“位移冲击”之间的区别，并研究了它们与外推信念的相互作用。在正常时期，PET产生持续的外推效应和动量。而在增加不确定性的位移冲击发生后，PET导致更强且时变的外推效应，从而引发泡沫与内生性崩盘。我们的理论在统一框架下，既阐释了正常时期的市场动态，也揭示了金德尔伯格关于泡沫的叙事。（JEL D84, G12, G41）
title: Partial Equilibrium Thinking, Extrapolation, and Bubbles
title_zh: 局部均衡思维、外推与泡沫

abstract: Using data on interbank relationships and note holdings in Pennsylvania, I estimate the probability that a bank will redeem the notes of other banks by the distance separating them. If two banks were separated by 50 miles, there was a 40 percent probability that a bank would hold the notes of another at a given time. At 200 miles, the estimated probability is virtually zero. My analysis of notes discounted by a small-town, Connecticut banknote broker reveals that distant notes were offered by travelers and traders who moved along the era’s principal waterways.
abstract_zh: 基于宾夕法尼亚州银行间关系与票据持有数据，本文估算了银行赎回其他银行票据的概率与地理距离的关联。若两家银行相距50英里，特定时点一家银行持有另一家银行票据的概率为40%；当距离增至200英里时，该概率几乎为零。通过对康涅狄格州小镇票据经纪人折价票据的分析发现，远距离票据主要由沿当时主要水路流动的旅行者与商人提供。
title: The Extent of the Market for Early American Banknotes
title_zh: 早期美国纸币的市场范围

abstract: This study examines the causal impact of tax education on property tax compliance in Benin. Utilizing a randomized controlled trial, two distinct interventions—deterrence and persuasion—were implemented to evaluate their effectiveness. The findings indicate that both approaches significantly and positively influence taxpayer behavior compared to those who received no intervention. However, the deterrence treatment demonstrates a stronger causal effect than the persuasion approach. A formal Clogg-Paternoster test confirms that the difference between the two treatments is not statistically significant at conventional levels. Therefore, assignments were made with the same intensity. Moreover, taxpayers exposed to deterrence measures paid, on average, 30.19% more than those in the control group, representing an additional 9,588 XOF. A cost-effectiveness analysis suggests that the deterrence-based intervention yields higher returns per unit of implementation cost compared to the persuasion approach.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了税收教育对贝宁房产税遵从度的因果影响。通过随机对照试验，实施了两项不同的干预措施——威慑与劝导——以评估其有效性。结果表明，与未接受任何干预的对照组相比，这两种方法均显著且积极地影响了纳税人的行为。然而，威慑处理显示出比劝导方法更强的因果效应。正式的Clogg-Paternoster检验确认，在常规显著性水平下，两种处理之间的差异在统计上并不显著。因此，任务分配以相同强度进行。此外，接触威慑措施的纳税人平均比对照组多支付30.19%，相当于额外缴纳9，588西非法郎。成本效益分析表明，基于威慑的干预措施每单位实施成本产生的回报高于劝导方法。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Incentives versus deterrent measures and tax compliance of landowners in Benin: a randomized controlled trial approach
title_zh: 贝宁土地所有者激励与威慑措施对税收遵从的影响：一项随机对照试验研究

abstract: In societies where ethnic identity is salient and political institutions are weak, parties often promise ethnicity-specific public goods during elections – promises that voters view with skepticism. These strategies involve a trade-off between mobilizing co-ethnic voters and alienating others. Weak institutions increase the rent from office and lower the cost of reneging on promises. This paper analyzes equilibrium policy outcomes when candidates value both winning and implementing their preferred ethnicity-specific public goods, with deviations from announced platforms being costly. It provides a complete characterization of equilibrium policy implementation across all possible configurations of party ideal platforms. We find that even with low positive costs of non-commitment and office motivation, parties choose to announce their ideal platforms in equilibrium, regardless of bias alignment. This “ideal implementation zone” contracts as non-commitment costs and office motivation increase. When parties have opposing ethnic biases, the zone expands for the majority-biased party and contracts for the minority-biased one as the majority’s size increases. Additionally, we find that the higher provisioning of ethnic public goods is more likely in poorer societies characterized by a large majority group and weak political institutions.
abstract_zh: 在族群认同显著且政治制度薄弱的社会中，政党往往在选举期间承诺针对特定族群的公共产品——而选民对此类承诺持怀疑态度。这些策略涉及在动员同族选民与疏远其他选民之间的权衡。制度薄弱增加了执政的租金，并降低了违背承诺的成本。本文分析了当候选人既重视赢得选举又重视实施其偏好的族群特定公共产品，且偏离已宣布纲领需付出成本时的均衡政策结果。我们提供了在所有可能的政党理想纲领配置下均衡政策实施的完整刻画。研究发现，即使背弃承诺的成本和执政动机较低且为正，政党在均衡中仍会选择宣布其理想纲领，无论偏见方向如何。这一“理想实施区间”随着背弃承诺成本和执政动机的增加而收缩。当政党具有对立的族群偏见时，随着多数群体规模的增大，偏向多数群体的政党的区间扩大，而偏向少数群体的政党的区间缩小。此外，我们发现，在由庞大多数群体和薄弱政治制度所表征的较贫困社会中，族群公共产品供给水平更高的可能性更大。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Ethnic bias, commitment and public good provisioning
title_zh: 民族偏见、承诺与公共品供给

abstract: We consider a team contest in which players make efforts to compete with other teams for a prize, and players of the winning team divide the prize according to a prize-sharing rule. Assuming that players differ in their abilities and their abilities are observable, we analyze which team structure realizes by allowing players to move across teams. A team structure is stable if there is no successful head-hunting opportunity. We show that if all teams employ the egalitarian sharing rule, then the complete sorting of players according to their abilities occurs, and inter-team inequality becomes the largest. In contrast, if all teams employ a substantially unequal sharing rule, there is a stable team structure with a small inter-team inequality and a large intra-team inequality. This result illustrates a trade-off between intra-team inequality and inter-team inequality in forming teams.
abstract_zh: 我们考察一种团队竞赛，其中队员为争夺奖品而与其他团队竞争，获胜团队的队员依据某种奖品分配规则分享奖品。假设队员能力各异且这些能力可被观察，我们分析允许队员跨团队流动时，何种团队结构得以实现。若不存在成功的挖角机会，则团队结构是稳定的。我们证明，若所有团队采用均等分配规则，则队员将按能力完全分层，团队间不平等达到最大。相反，若所有团队采用显著不均等的分配规则，则存在一种稳定的团队结构，其团队间不平等较小而团队内不平等较大。这一结果揭示了团队形成过程中团队内不平等与团队间不平等之间的权衡关系。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Formation of teams in contests: tradeoffs between inter- and intra-team inequalities
title_zh: 竞赛中团队的形成：团队间与团队内不平等的权衡

abstract: The approach by Engelberg et al. (2009) to convert probabilistic survey responses into continuous probability distributions implicitly assumes that the question intervals are equally wide. Almost all recently established surveys have intervals of unequal width. Applying the standard approach to these surveys gives implausible and potentially misleading results. This note shows how the approach of Engelberg et al. (2009) can be adjusted to account for intervals of unequal width.
abstract_zh: Engelberg等人（2009年）将概率调查回答转换为连续概率分布的方法，隐含假设了问题区间宽度相等。然而，几乎所有近期建立的调查都采用了不等宽区间。将标准方法应用于这些调查，会产生不合理且可能具有误导性的结果。本文展示了如何调整Engelberg等人（2009年）的方法，以适应不等宽区间的情况。
title: Extending the procedure of Engelberg et al. (2009) to surveys with unequal interval widths
title_zh: 将Engelberg等人(2009)的方法扩展到不等区间宽度的调查
